name: inspiration

description: A realization that prompts you towards an action.

guidance.description: Inspiration doesn't always happen on demand, but these articles have suggestions about creating conditions that might help get inspired.

commentaries.quote: Inspiration can lead to aspiration can lead to ambition.
You never know who or what will inspire you.
Play. Explore. Stare at strangers. Talk to friends. Go swanning about, looking for inspiration. It’s a crucial part of of our creative process.
